at the end of both apply functions; dev-tree lines 70/107 present, absent in 47.0.70).

Impact on this run: none after recovery — implement-bootstrap-invoke.sh had already exited 0 and
written a complete bootstrap-routing.env; the orchestrator recovered routing values by reading that
file directly instead of re-sourcing the broken parser.
EOF
